title: ShellRp
description: Resource pack for a smoother gameplay experience on the ShellWorlds server, featuring new customizable totems.
body:
**ShellWorlds** Custom Resource Pack: Elevate Your Experience
Welcome to the official custom resource pack for the ShellWorlds server! This pack is meticulously designed to seamlessly integrate with our server's unique world and provide a drastically improved, visually cohesive, and highly customizable gameplay experience for all our players.

Core Philosophy:
Our goal is to enhance the vanilla Minecraft feel, not replace it. Every texture and addition is crafted to fit the classic art style while adding new layers of depth, personalization, and performance to your time on ShellWorlds.

**Key Features & Benefits:**
1. Brand New Customizable Totems:

Go beyond the standard Totem of Undying! Our pack introduces a complete set of new totems, each with its own unique model and texture.

These totems aren't just for show—they function as your key to customization. Use them to access special visual effects, animations, or perks (as per the server's plugin setup).

**Find and collect them all to showcase your achievements and style!**

2. Enhanced Visuals & Immersion:

Updated Main Menu Panorama: Immerse yourself in the world of ShellWorlds from the very moment you log in. The new dynamic panorama showcases iconic landscapes and builds from our server.

Consistent Texture Work: Enjoy a visually harmonious world. We've fixed bugs and refined default textures to ensure everything from blocks to items looks crisp and consistent within our server's theme.

Environmental Details: Subtle changes to skies, water, and lighting create a more atmospheric and unique feel for the ShellWorlds universe.

3. Optimized Performance & Clarity:

Smoother Gameplay: The pack is optimized to reduce visual clutter and strain, potentially offering better frame rates for a wider range of PCs.

Clear Visual Cues: Important items, UI elements, and server-specific blocks are designed to be easily identifiable, removing guesswork and improving your efficiency in gameplay, especially in PVP or complex builds.

4. Deep Server Integration:

This isn't a generic pack; it's built specifically for ShellWorlds. It works hand-in-hand with our custom plugins to unlock its full potential, ensuring features like the new totems function correctly and add meaningful gameplay value.
